task.description: Security gate on ISS-0534's new log line on the authentication path, focused on INV-4 (secrets never logged).

result.note: INV-1 not applicable, log-only diff, no query/prefix/scoping logic touched. INV-4 applies, PASS: traced every reachable reason shape at auth_pipeline.ex:177-178 -- :jit_disabled intercepted earlier and never reaches this log line; :invalid_tenant_id plug-local atom; :external_identity_collision atom from identity.ex:1543; %Ecto.Changeset{} from insert_or_fetch/4's {:error, changeset} (identity.ex:1478-1520). Read User.jit_changeset/2 (identity/user.ex:62-77): casts only external_realm/external_id/username/display_name/email/status from caller-built attrs (never the raw token); password_hash is unconditionally put_change'd to a fixed sentinel, never from attrs -- a changeset from this function can never carry a raw credential/password hash/token. None of the castable fields are secret material under INV-4. Compared against identity.ex:774-789's safe_get_tenant_by_slug/2 precedent (never logs a raw caught exception since it could carry connection strings/query text): this new line is narrower, inspecting a typed known-shape result not an arbitrary exception -- consistent with, not looser than, established caution. New test fixtures use only synthetic values, no real-looking secret material. INV-7/2/3/5/9 not applicable (no SQL/response-shaping/sandboxing/lookup-by-id/outbound-URL code touched). INV-8 applies, PASS: inspect/1 is total over all Elixir terms including structs with an Inspect impl, cannot raise on any reachable reason shape. Real test run: mix test test/letflow/plugs/auth_pipeline_test.exs test/letflow/plugs/auth_pipeline_configurable_verifier_test.exs -- 14 passed, 0 failures.
